headline: South Africa Faces Tariff Increases as U.S. Exits AGOA Program
summary: South Africa's graduation from the AGOA trade program introduces a 3.4% tariff bump for exports to the U.S. Industry representatives warn the move risks up to 10,000 local jobs and impacts the American citrus supply chain.
why: The African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA) provides duty-free access to the U.S. market for qualifying sub-Saharan African nations, supporting regional manufacturing and agricultural exports.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Removal from duty-free trade status imposes higher tariffs on exports to the United States.
